scripts.docker:local:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file .env.docker.local --profile tools run --rm seed
scripts.docker:prod:config: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.yml -f deployment/docker-compose.scale.yml config
scripts.docker:prod:migrate: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production pull migrate && docker compose --env-file .env.production up --no-build migrate
scripts.docker:prod:up: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production pull backend frontend migrate && docker compose --env-file .env.production up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:prod:scale: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.yml -f deployment/docker-compose.scale.yml pull backend frontend migrate && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.yml -f deployment/docker-compose.scale.yml up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:prod:backup: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production run --rm backup once
scripts.docker:prod:restore-drill: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile recovery run --rm -e RUN_RESTORE_DRILL=1 restore-drill
scripts.docker:prod:pitr-verify: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile recovery run --rm pitr-verify
scripts.docker:prod:pitr-restore-drill: pnpm docker:prod:validate && docker compose --env-file .env.production --profile recovery run --rm -e RUN_PITR_RESTORE_DRILL=1 pitr-restore-drill
scripts.docker:prod:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.production logs -f nginx backend migrate pgbouncer
